_notes: Foreign (non-KZ) university duplicates surfaced by two independent signals while running the uniranks world-rank pass (see generate_uniranks_world_rank_review.py): (1) two DB rows sharing an exact normalized (name, country) key but a different city — almost always the same institution with one row carrying a wrong/generic city inherited from a study-abroad-agency-style source; (2) two DB rows resolving to the SAME uniranks.com profile page despite having differently-scripted names (English original vs uniranks' own Russian translation).

Every merge pair below was checked by hand: program count, image count, ovpo_code, ror_id per side (ror_id in particular marks a row that was deliberately curated via scripts/find_ror_id.py, so it wins as merge target even when the other side has one more program). 'keep' is the target that survives; 'remove' is merged into it and deleted.

Groups that are NOT merge candidates are listed under no_action with why: either the second entry is a genuine sub-unit/department/college with its own admissions programs (National University of Singapore's schools, University of Cape Town's Faculty of Law, Jagiellonian's Medical College, Politecnico di Milano's Scuola del Design, the Beijing/Chongqing affiliate colleges) and merging would destroy real distinct catalog entries, or the two names are a pure translation coincidence between two genuinely different real-world institutions (Университет Виктории = University of Victoria Canada AND Victoria University Australia; likewise Вестминстера and Нью-Ингленда) — those three already had their wrongly-shared uniranks_world_rank cleared directly in the DB since it's impossible to tell which one (if either) the rank actually belongs to.
